## 📊 Copilot usage and ROI report **CoolEngOrg** · teams: platform-eng, payments · 2026-08-23 to 2026-09-19 (28 days with data) | Metric | Value | | ------ | ----- | | Total cost | **$1,293.03** ($892.63 AI credits + $400.40 seats) | | AI credits | 89,263.3 ($892.63) | | Active / engaged users | 10 / 8 (80% engaged) | | Merged pull requests | 44 | | Cost per merged PR | **$29.39** (AI only $20.29) | | Median time to merge | 35.0 h | | Code acceptance rate | 40% · 18,605 AI-assisted lines added | ### Findings - 8 of 10 active Copilot users (80%) were engaged: they accepted code or used an agentic surface (agent mode, CLI, cloud agent) on the day. - 50% of active users used an agentic surface (agent mode, CLI, Copilot app or cloud agent) at least once. - Total cost per merged pull request: $29.39 (AI credits alone: $20.29). - Lowest cost per merged PR: payments ($21.98); highest: platform-eng ($36.80). - AI-credit spend in the second half of the period changed +26% versus the first half.
Teams (2) | Team | Seats | Active | Engaged | Total cost | Merged PRs | Cost / PR | Median cycle | | ---- | ----- | ------ | ------- | ---------- | ---------- | --------- | ------------ | | platform-eng | 6 | 5 | 4 | $809.49 | 22 | $36.80 | 33.0 h | | payments | 5 | 5 | 4 | $483.54 | 22 | $21.98 | 37.0 h |
📦 **Artifacts:** [download the report bundle](https://github.com/CoolEngOrg/issueops/actions/runs/9100020101/artifacts/4200000201) (interactive `copilot-roi.html` with table views), CSV exports, `report.json`. Artifacts are retained for 30 days. 📈 Metrics were pushed to the Pushgateway and appear on the **IssueOps / Copilot ROI** Grafana dashboard.
Notes and definitions - Teams with fewer than five Copilot-seated users are omitted from GitHub's user-teams report; users on several teams count toward each of their teams, so team rows do not sum to the scope total. - AI-assisted lines of code (loc_added_sum) are directional: they measure Copilot-suggested lines accepted or applied, not total output. - **AI cost**: ai_credits_used x $0.0100 per credit (config pricing.ai_credit_usd) - **active user**: a Copilot-seated user with any interaction, generation, acceptance or agent use on a day - **cost per merged PR**: total cost in scope / merged pull requests in scope - **cycle time**: pull request created -> merged, in hours - **engaged user**: accepted code or used an agentic surface (agent mode, CLI, cloud agent) on the day - **seat cost**: seats x $39.00 per month x days/30 (Copilot Enterprise)
